build_gguf_model_loader: build a GGUF model loader class that loads quantized GGUF models into vLLM with support for sharded files
create_gguf_weights_map: create a GGUF-to-HF weight name mapping for a model config handling multimodal and text-only architectures
discover_gguf_shards: discover all GGUF shard files from a single shard path with variable-width index padding
load_gguf_weights: load GGUF model weights into a PyTorch module using a weight iterator and name mapping
load_gguf_model: load a complete GGUF model into vLLM initializing the model, loading weights, and processing after loading
